name: av_obv
description:
On-balance volume for one stock from Alpha Vantage (OBV).
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Technical Analysis: OBV"} keyed by date or timestamp, each with OBV. Alpha Vantage's JSON comes back unchanged, including its "Error Message" or "Information" notes; a network failure gives {"error": ...}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly; default daily); time_period (accepted by the schema but not sent to Alpha Vantage).
Use it for whether volume confirms price moves; av_ad_line weights volume by close location. Raw prices: av_stock_daily.
Key: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY (alpha_vantage.api.key); when unset the 'demo' key is sent, which only serves Alpha Vantage's documentation examples. Free tier: 25 requests/day.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "daily"}

interval.description: Bar interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly

time_period.description: Not sent to Alpha Vantage by this tool; the indicator uses its default periods
